hints.title: Valid Capitalization Grammar
hints.text: Only three patterns are valid: all letters are capitals, all letters are lowercase, or only the very first letter is a capital.

hints.title: Capital Count Disjunction Invariant
hints.text: Counting total uppercase letters accepts the word if the count equals string length, equals zero, or equals one with the uppercase letter at index zero.

hints.title: Capital Count Evaluation Procedure
hints.text: Traverse the word to tally uppercase letters. If capital count equals word length, return true. If capital count is zero, return true. If capital count equals one and the first character is uppercase, return true. Otherwise return false.

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Regular expressions create regex engine overhead and memory allocation for simple single-case checks.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single traversal counting capital letters executes in O(N) time and requires strictly O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should identify the three acceptable conditions and write simple character condition checks.
